text:
sarah_pm: quick sync — i want to align on the long-term policy matrix for placement/region/tenant shielding. goal: clear launch gates for H2 roadmap so sales/security know what we can promise. TL;DR: need decisions on (1) affinity vs cost tiers, (2) per-tenant isolation options, (3) multi-region fallback behavior.

james_arch: +1. can we scope this as a matrix: row = routing policy, col = isolation level, then call out SLO/cost approx per cell? helps make tradeoffs visible to non-architects.

ashwin: small nit — i prefer "placement zones" vs "isolation level" naming in docs. placement zones = logical grouping e.g., "shared", "dedicated-pool", "pinned-vpc". saves ambiguity.

elaine: from oncall perspective, we need explicit failover semantics. e.g., if region A degrades, do we: (a) fail open to lower-tier model in same region, (b) reroute to healthy region (higher latency), or (c) reject? each has different alerting/playbook implications.

mohit: customers asking for two concrete things: 1) ability to require no-cross-region traffic for compliance, 2) predictable latency SLOs for user-facing latency-sensitive apps. they want explicit gating language for GA vs beta.

james_arch: noted. proposal: define three launch classes: GA, Controlled GA (opt-in tenants), Experimental. Map features to classes. Example: cross-region fallback = Experimental; dedicated VPC with strict no-egress = GA.

ashwin: engineering constraints: kernel selection & kv cache locality matter. If we do cross-region fallback often, KV cache warmups will tank p95 for a while. need a caching/replication plan in any cell that routes across regions.

elaine: add to that: metrics we need before GA: cross-region p50/p95 for token latency, error spike rate after failover, cold-KV penalty. If we don't hit thresholds, fallback must be disabled automatically.

mohit: also capture customer contractual language: for Controlled GA we should include "best-effort cross-region routing, no latency SLA" and an explicit opt-in checkbox in contract. That stops sales from promising SLAs prematurely.

james_arch: rough draft matrix (will refine):
```
Policies: affinity | cost-tier | region-fallback
Placement zones: shared | dedicated-pool | pinned-vpc
Launch-class mapping: Experimental | Controlled-GA | GA
Impacts: SLOs, KV-warmup, billing delta, security controls
```

james_arch: action items: 1) eng-runtime to estimate kv-warmup penalty per policy (ashwin), 2) oncall to propose gating metrics and thresholds (elaine), 3) legal/sales to draft Controlled-GA contract language (mohit), 4) product to finalize matrix and rollout plan (sarah_pm).

ashwin: i can run a microbench next week to quantify cold-kv penalty for cross-region hops. estimate: 8-20% p95 increase depending on model size. will post numbers.

elaine: i'll draft a gating doc with hard thresholds and playbook snippets. propose we require recovery to baseline within 30m after failover for GA.

mohit: i'll draft the contract wording and get early feedback from the top 3 enterprise prospects who requested this.

deploy-bot: deploy completed to staging: routing-matrix-ui v0.3 — contains initial matrix view + toggles for Controlled-GA.

sarah_pm: thanks all. next sync Thurs 10am. i'll convert james' matrix into a one-pager and share before the meeting. please add any docs/links in thread. :thumbsup:
